description: ECR repository has neither observed active Inspector coverage nor enabling registry scan configuration
rationale: Inspector reports absent/inactive enrollment while the repository is not matched by enhanced scanning rules or BASIC scanOnPush is false. This is a candidate gap in scanning enrollment. Neither Inspector ACTIVE nor scanOnPush alone verifies that any particular image was scanned; image-level scan results were not collected.
remediation: Enable and validate Inspector enhanced scanning or an appropriate ECR basic scanning policy; inspect actual image scan statuses and last scans separately.
